findings.evidence: Lines 91–96 expose the body; lines 117–155 and 186–225 rely on its definitional Finsupp representation, while lines 148–150 already define an abstract path-indexed basis whose values can characterize the object without unfolding it.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]`; state the action, constructor, and universal-property lemmas using `indecProjRepBasis k i j p` (including a simp lemma for mapping basis vectors), and keep raw Finsupp/map formulas private or behind explicit transports.
findings.issue: `@[expose]` makes the complete `Paths.lift` implementation of `indecProjRep` unfoldable downstream merely so public lemmas can mention `Finsupp.single` definitionally.

summary: The core representation remains exposed to support implementation-specific Finsupp statements, although its existing basis can provide an opaque characteristic API.
